findings.title: Cross-service DNS failures
findings.observation: 49 Network request failures across nine hosts; an additional ReadUrl DNS failure.
findings.recommendation: Investigate phone network/DNS/VPN transitions; use a network-wide connectivity gate rather than spending every engine retry on a common outage.

findings.title: Local MCP gateways unreachable
findings.observation: 10 connect timeouts on port 8101 and 10 on 8102; 8-second connection deadlines. Consecutive failure counters reach 12.
findings.evidence: L26–28 and L6162–6164; reconstructed Network events.
findings.recommendation: Verify gateway service and route; keep offline endpoints out of dispatch; verify existing backoff and single-flight paths cover UI refreshes and background work.

findings.title: Long research preparation before answer model
findings.observation: Turn 682:7711 setup at 18:10:43.366Z; primary model request at 18:35:58.087Z. Turn 681:7708 setup at 18:11:50.122Z; primary at 18:24:36.954Z.
findings.recommendation: Stream results and split discovery/fetch/analysis into independent work queues. These are not measurements of time to the first discovered source.

findings.title: Local chat model unavailable
findings.observation: Selected Gemma 4 E2B GPU .litertlm profile fails immediately because its model is not downloaded; zero tools exposed in that attempt.
findings.recommendation: Admit only ready model artifacts and initialized backends; expose a clear Download required state and fall back to authorized available workers.

findings.title: Model download interrupted and foreground cleanup failed
findings.confidence: Confirmed in log; immediate underlying worker exception not recorded
findings.observation: Last progress 1,360,409,963 of 2,008,432,640 bytes; stop reason 11; worker FAILURE; BackgroundServiceStartNotAllowedException during foreground cleanup.
findings.evidence: L5150–5176; D2 identifies reason 11 as BACKGROUND_RESTRICTION.
findings.recommendation: Preserve and resume partial data, classify background restriction accurately, and repair foreground lifecycle handling. Range-resume and validation already exist in R10.

findings.title: Cancellation reasons are misleading
findings.confidence: Confirmed label; individual cancellation causes not fully observable
findings.observation: 14 Canceled by parent run events: 13 read_paper and one search_papers. The same research runs continue and later synthesize.
findings.recommendation: Differentiate page timeout, provider timeout, user stop, permission revocation and parent cancellation. Do not classify every CancellationException as parent cancellation.

findings.title: Budget accounting lock contention
findings.observation: 252 ms monitor contention in ResearchRunLedger.charge, with two waiters; the synchronized method invokes persistent checkpointing.
findings.recommendation: Use durable reservation/WAL accounting plus coalesced snapshots; preserve crash-safe budget semantics and avoid synchronous disk snapshots per network chunk.

findings.title: Perplexity Search authorization failure
findings.observation: POST /search returns HTTP 401. Exact credential failure is not visible.
findings.recommendation: Validate the search-specific credential and access; mark authentication required instead of retrying as an ordinary engine outage.

findings.title: MCP protocol fallback noise and optional-stream handling
findings.confidence: Confirmed response patterns; end-to-end tool failure not proved by these statuses
findings.observation: Jina and Firecrawl each show six POST 400 responses followed by legacy_fallback; Firecrawl additionally returns two GET 405 responses with Allow: POST. Successful POST responses also occur.
findings.recommendation: Cache negotiated transport capability and separate discovery/optional SSE from actual tool outcomes. Optional GET 405 can be valid MCP behavior.

findings.title: Invalid output-token cap, recovered
findings.observation: Requested max_tokens 256000 exceeds upstream completion limit 131072. Retry corrects the cap and completes.
findings.recommendation: Preflight provider-route completion capabilities; distinguish context window from output limit and retain the learned compatible cap.

findings.title: Large tool-schema estimate / accounting ambiguity
findings.confidence: Confirmed in log; transmitted size not established
findings.observation: Estimated tool schemas 39,478 of 46,251 input tokens, but progressive catalog says 77 authorized and 25 initially advertised.
findings.recommendation: Measure the actual transmitted catalog and expose a small research facade, loading other authorized tools on demand. Do not claim all 77 tools were sent.

findings.title: Specific page retrieval failures
findings.observation: Frontiers DNS failure, NewHealthAdvisor connection failure, AP News HTTP 403.
findings.recommendation: Keep site, transport and reader failures separate. Respect denied access; select independently accessible sources rather than bypassing the denied page.

findings.title: Download progress / foreground churn
findings.observation: 795 WorkProgressUpdater entries, 795 foreground-move entries and 794 notification entries for one transfer. R10 repeatedly calls setForeground inside the progress loop.
findings.recommendation: Keep foreground lifecycle separate from notification updates; throttle database/log writes and update the notification only on a meaningful cadence.

findings.title: UI / allocation / compilation performance signals
findings.confidence: Confirmed in log; exact root-cause contributions need profiling
findings.observation: Skipped 61, 42 and 34 frames; 174 ms thread suspension / GC pause; repeated allocations; ChatRepositoryImpl completeChat coroutine exceeds compiler instruction limit at 53,224 instructions.
findings.recommendation: Split the giant coroutine into components; profile allocations, checkpoint work and UI recompositions in a release build. No fatal crash or ANR is demonstrated by these entries.

findings.title: Deferred memory enrichment and embedding reloads
findings.confidence: Confirmed state; deferred completion not a fault by itself
findings.observation: Memory enrichment waits for NO_LOADED_MODEL. Four embedding engine generations are released on memory pressure; handles return to zero.
findings.recommendation: Verify model-ready wake-up for deferred enrichment; keep deferred state distinct from semantic success; avoid unnecessary reloads. No native handle leak is shown.

findings.title: Pending providers are not implemented/validated active engines
findings.observation: 37 registry entries; 7 ready capabilities, 30 not ready. Only five are native keyword-search engines.
findings.recommendation: Separate integration state, current health and run queue state. Implement and contract-test adapters before marking them ready.

findings.title: Whole-pass turn lock prevents cooperative scheduling
findings.observation: ResearchSessionStore shares a corpus and budget per chat/turn, but withTaskLock holds a turn-keyed mutex across the entire AndroidResearchWorkflow run.
findings.recommendation: Keep the shared corpus but replace whole-pass locking with short atomic job claims, leases and result subscriptions.

findings.title: Discovery and reading are blocked behind slow work
findings.observation: Sequential query stages; provider awaitAll; academic page search drains current metadata reads before advancing; batch readers use awaitAll; lower effort academic reads are sequential.
findings.recommendation: Use completion-driven bounded worker pools and continuously refill free slots. Surface fast results without waiting for a slow provider or an entire page of candidates.

findings.title: Academic full-text and general readers are separate paths
findings.observation: Native read refuses PDFs, requires particular HTML/XML content, and returns metadata_only when no OA URL exists. Crossref/DataCite parsers do not populate OA URLs. Academic reading uses only deep_research_read_paper.
findings.recommendation: Create a capability registry spanning native HTML/XML, approved remote readers and gateway/local PDF parsing. Route eligible paper URLs into it while preserving paper identity and provenance.

findings.title: Source discovery can outgrow usable-evidence yield
findings.observation: New canonical metadata prevents stagnation even when little full text is obtained. Candidate source count differs from readableWorkCount. Partial useful results below the goal return FAILED.
findings.recommendation: Track marginal readable and claim-support yield, prioritize accessible candidates, and return PARTIAL_USEFUL rather than failing useful coverage. Never inflate readable counts with abstracts or duplicate copies.

findings.title: Timeout and reader failures lose detail
findings.observation: invoke catches ordinary exceptions to null; outer timeout also returns null; concurrent academic reads collapse unreadable reasons to Failed.
findings.recommendation: Use typed terminal states and preserve error category, source, HTTP status, retry time and cancellation origin.

findings.title: Provider routing and duplicate coalescing gaps
findings.observation: Routed provider list is fixed; at lower depth some providers may not be selected. Cache checked before provider semaphore and not rechecked afterward; cache key includes entire request.
findings.recommendation: Use capability-aware fair scheduling, canonical query keys and single-flight results; recheck cache after admission. This is a race risk, not proof every logged request duplicated.

findings.title: Local quota policy is distinct from provider limits
findings.confidence: Code-confirmed; no specific academic 429 is visible in this export
findings.observation: Native local daily counter is 50 for OpenAlex and 500 for others, in addition to spacing/cooldowns. Current OpenAlex documentation supports anonymous use and optional free-key expansion.
findings.recommendation: Display local policy versus real provider quota; support optional credentials and rate-limit headers. Do not report a missing OpenAlex key as this log’s proven failure cause.

findings.title: Engine metrics do not represent useful source success
findings.observation: Native telemetry measures HTTP completion, counts redirects as success, and does not express parsing/full-text yield; facade errors are not the same as individual provider states. Cancellation is excluded from rollup live attempts.
findings.recommendation: Separate transport, search, read, extraction, evidence and delivery outcomes; report cancellations and no-result responses separately and export the underlying native telemetry.

findings.title: Telemetry repeatedly scans files and can interrupt acquisition
findings.confidence: Code-confirmed risk, not an observed storage-limit hit
findings.observation: rollup scans and parses the directory on every call; status calls rollup three times for each provider. record scans for count and throws at 100,000 files; it is called inside fetch finally.
findings.recommendation: Use indexed aggregate storage; keep telemetry fail-soft and retention incremental. A statistics write must not turn successful retrieval into a failure.

findings.title: Checkpoint scaling and active-time race risks
findings.observation: save rewrites/rechecks all source references frequently under a store lock; load(task) scans history. Multiple concurrent operation loops share a non-atomic measuredAt and charge active time.
findings.recommendation: Persist source deltas and job changes; centralize a monotonic run clock. Test concurrent timing, restoration, history growth and the stop state of sibling run IDs.

findings.title: Parallel legacy local research path differs from the new path
findings.observation: LocalResearchWorkflow uses its own bounded preparation logic, local source map and saved source subset; AndroidResearchWorkflow uses the newer goal-ledger path.
findings.recommendation: Make local assistance a worker of the common orchestrator rather than an independent crawler with different accounting, deadlines and corpus semantics.

limitations: Screenshot is only 148 x 1536; exact settings not transcribed.
Native per-provider research telemetry not present in this export.
